title: Electric field magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly states the final expression for the electric field magnitude, E = (3mg)/(4q) or equivalent.

title: Acceleration magnitude
description: Essential: Correctly states the final expression for the block's acceleration, a = (21g)/20 or equivalent.

title: Final speed
description: Essential: Correctly states the final expression for the speed at the ground, v = sqrt(7gH/2) or equivalent.

title: Force equilibrium setup
description: Important: For part (1), resolves forces (gravity, normal, electric) along the incline or axes to set up the equilibrium condition.

title: Newton's second law application
description: Important: For part (2), applies Newton's second law along the incline with the new electric force to find acceleration.

title: Kinematics application
description: Important: Uses constant-acceleration kinematics (v^2 = u^2 + 2as) with correct displacement (H/sin37°) to find final speed.

title: Trigonometric function usage
description: Optional: Correctly uses sin37°=0.6 and cos37°=0.8 in force components or displacement.

title: Sign/direction error
description: Pitfall: Misplaces the direction of the electric force in either part, leading to incorrect force components.

title: Incorrect displacement
description: Pitfall: Uses H instead of H/sin37° for the distance traveled along the incline in the kinematics step.
